main_body: Round stone tower with a conical green tile roof, a brown eave, a window with a flower box, and an arched wooden door
top_band: Green tile roof slope, rows ~5-39 at x=23 (light to dark greens with tile-course lines), followed by a brown eave/dark edge at rows 40-41
evidence: The cone roof reads as a large sloped surface seen from above, with tile courses and a lit left side. A brown eave line and dark underside separate it from the stone front face (rows 42-94). The front face has its own shading, brick courses, a window with a frame and sill, and a door set into a stone surround. The roof and the wall both satisfy the 3/4 contract, similar to the reference houses.

style.evidence: The roof carries about 6 green steps with per-tile highlights and dark seams, and the stone has about 5 grey steps with a speckled brick pattern. Outlines are tinted dark teal and brown (0% neutral edge pixels). Flat-fill coverage is 1%. At 31 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile it is below the references (11 and 18), but the structure and shading craft are comparable, so it would not look out of place beside them.
